lines.5: 「There's a good breeze here, so it's perfect for cooling you down.」
lines.6: 「Oh, that's right... I overheated in the bath.」
lines.7: 「...If I overheated in the bath up on the mountain, why am I lying on the beach?」
lines.10: 「You wouldn't wake up at all, and if you were overheated, leaving you somewhere that hot wasn't a good idea.」
lines.11: 「You carried me... while I was asleep...? In my swimsuit?」
lines.14: 「Hey! What's wrong all of a sudden!?」
lines.15: 「Th-this is so embarrassing... I'm going to die.」
lines.16: Her face was bright red all over again.
lines.18: Still lying down, she rolled back and forth across the sand.
lines.19: Apparently this was her way of expressing embarrassment.
